holdout: Entire Pan-M Gold sealed; no access

models.morphospatial_90: 19 morphology plus raw intensity, edge/inner, local-reference, 12-sector, displacement and neighbor-side features

missing_data: Native NaN handling; no rows dropped for QC
feature_scaling: No cell-level normalization; tree model uses saved raw features
training_validation: Three leave-one-original-training-WSI-out folds for descriptive out-of-fold metrics; not used for parameter or threshold selection
baseline: Previously frozen SCIMAP GMM outputs joined after extraction; exact same labelled cells evaluated
stats: Per original split and per WSI/core; pooled metrics plus unit-level distributions; descriptive, not independent-cell hypothesis tests
